description: The entity does not specify objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to objectives.
applicability: Applies to all entities when security, availability, confidentiality, privacy, or processing integrity objectives are not clearly defined, documented, or measurable.

metadata.detection_notes: Review strategic plans, security objectives documentation, service level objectives, risk management framework, and operational goals. Look for absence of documented objectives, vague or unmeasurable goals, or objectives that do not align with SOC 2 trust service criteria.
